【Caption】
A bright and uplifting 120bpm summer marching anthem song, featuring emotional, clear female vocal with gentle vibrato and powerful belting, about a joyful parade walking through sunlit golden streets lined with blooming flowers and children playing, filled with warm, nostalgic, and energetic atmosphere, with acoustic guitar, electric guitar, piano, brass section, and polished production with lush reverb and analog warmth.

【Lyrics】
[Intro]
(Synth shimmer and light percussion build up)

[Verse]
阳光洒在肩头 微风轻轻吹过
金色的麦浪 在田野里跳跃

[Pre-Chorus]
脚步不再沉重 梦想开始飞翔
听见心跳节奏 和着夏日乐章

[Chorus]
夏天进行曲 奏响希望旋律
Oh yeah 脚步轻盈 走向明天去
夏天进行曲 唤醒心中活力
Woah 让爱传递 在每个呼吸里

[Bridge]
汗水与泪水 都是成长的印记
每一步向前 都不再犹豫

[Chorus]
夏天进行曲 奏响希望旋律
Oh yeah 脚步轻盈 走向明天去
夏天进行曲 唤醒心中活力
Woah 让爱传递 在每个呼吸里

[Outro]
(Fading out with bright synth and soft claps)
夏天进行曲... 永远不停息
